title: 下拉框
summary: 往下展开只是外观。先定提交的是一个值、一组、一条路径，还是一次动作。
summaryEn: Opening downward is only the look. First decide whether it commits a value, a set, a path, or an action.
asks: 往下展开的面板提交什么？
asksEn: What does this downward panel commit?

links.when: 往下展开的提交模型，不是先问填还是选
links.whenEn: a downward panel’s commit model is not fill-versus-pick
